mapper.select: SELECT bc.id, bc.user_id, u.name, bc.content, bc.created_at FROM board_comments bc JOIN users u ON bc.user_id = u.id WHERE bc.id = #{id} AND bc.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board_comments (user_id, board_id, content) VALUES (#{comment.userId}, #{boardId}, #{comment.content})
mapper.update: UPDATE board_comments SET content = #{comment.content}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{comment.id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM board_comments WHERE deleted_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{pivot} MINUTE)
